observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 182.» (L19) in the left margin. In «p. 182.» the 2 is printed broken, its top curl and its foot apart; read as 182 after «p. 181.» (p. 119). The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 50: 10 stands beside «CAPUT L.», 15 beside L11.
body L8-L10: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.

body L3-L4: the transliterations are printed «ash–Shi‘rà al–yamāniyyah» and «ash–Shi‘rà ash–sha’miyyah», with the ‘ayn as a turned comma and a grave accent on the final a (measured on the scan); in «sha’miyyah» the hamza is written ’.
body L7, L14: the letters of the references (b) and (a) are bold italic; with chapter 50 the letters begin again at a.
body L15, L19, L26, L27, L32, L34, notes_right L4, L6: «1ᵖ», «64ᵖ», «33ᵖ», «115ᵖ», «38ᵖ» and «18ᵖ» are written with a small raised italic p (partes).
body L20: in «αἰθήρ» the eta is printed broken, its first stroke joined to the theta.
body L28, L30: a speck stands before «terminum»; the e of «ea» after «In» has a hook at its foot, like ę.
notes_left L1, L3: a speck stands before «(1)»; the closing parenthesis of «(3)» is printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
